description: This file defines a PHP class EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams that extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate filter parameters for searching email subscribers within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes properties for filtering based on 'enabled' status and a list of IDs, along with setter and getter methods. It also sets a default sort field during construction.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A class representing filter parameters specifically for searching email subscribers, providing properties for enabled status and list of IDs, along with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams, setting the default sort field to 'emailSubscriber.name'.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns the current enabled status filter; true, false, or null if not set.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the list of IDs used as a filter criterion, or null if not set.

methods.name: setIds
methods.description: Sets the list of IDs used for filtering email subscribers.
